plugins.Author: Kage
plugins.Name: QuickTransfer
plugins.Description: Automate inventory transfers with Shift/Ctrl/Alt + Right-Click. Trade window, vendor quick sell, FC chest.
plugins.Changelog:
**New**
- Redesigned settings window (`/qt`): everything on one page, each option sits under the shortcut it changes, and help is in hover tooltips.
- "Right now" line under Quick transfer and Armoury shows what a click will do with the windows you have open.
- Hover the info icon next to Quick transfer to see where items go for each window.
- Works on Japanese, German and French game clients.
- New navy and gold look.

**Fixes**
- Shift or Ctrl + middle-click no longer sells, deposits or moves a different item than the one you clicked.
- Middle-click no longer sorts when you click in another program, or when nothing is under the cursor.
- Holding Mouse 4 / 5 (for example push-to-talk) no longer turns a normal click into a sort.
- FC chest: moves now pause properly when another member is using the chest.
- Fixed a rare crash when an FC chest "How many?" box stayed open for a while, or the plugin updated while one was open.
- With "Fill in quantity prompts" off, split and FC chest boxes now show up straight away instead of staying hidden for a few seconds.
- The right-click menu no longer turns invisible or closes by itself right after a split or trade.
- A single right-click can no longer act twice on low frame rates.
- FC chest tidy no longer stops halfway on very messy tabs.

**Changed**
- Middle-click sort only sorts the window under your cursor.
- Removed the "Unlocked item tabs" setting. It had no effect.
- The version number now shows in the settings window title.

plugins.Author: Kage
plugins.Name: Relic Tracker
plugins.Punchline: Track relic materials across inventory and retainers.
plugins.Description: Track relic weapon, tool, and armor progress across every job, with live material counts and optional FFXIV Collect sync.
plugins.Changelog:
- Gather & Chill: each gatherable row now has a Gather button, plus a Stop button while it's gathering.
- Buttons for Artisan, Gather & Chill and Knightshopper now disappear when that plugin is turned off, and come back when it's on again.
- Knightshopper lists copied from the Tracker are now named "Relic Tracker - <currency>".
